title: File:Liangyou 057 cover Zhang Liying.jpg
depicts: Georgette Chen (as Zhang Liying), cover portrait photograph of Liangyou (The Young Companion) magazine no. 57
note: Tagged PD-China and PD-1996 on the file page. The only free photograph of her found anywhere. It is a photograph, not one of her paintings. The file is a small, heavily compressed JPEG (28 KB at 1080x1512), so expect compression artefacts; a pen trace will hide them. The cover masthead text may need cropping.

title: File:Zhang Jingjiang.jpg
depicts: Her father Zhang Jingjiang (Zhang Renjie), studio portrait
artist: Unknown photographer; scanned by 天竺鼠
note: Greyscale scan, low-res. Good for a small inset in the childhood or 'foreign potato' chapter. The file 'Zhang Jingjiang and his wife.jpg' was left out because it shows his second wife Zhu Yimin, not Georgette's mother.

title: File:陈友仁.jpg
depicts: Eugene Chen (Chen Youren), her first husband, wearing a hat
note: Taken before 1944 (exact year unknown). Usable for the Eugene chapter. Do not use her own portraits of Eugene (those are her paintings, still in copyright).

title: File:Carousel, Jardin des Tuileries, Paris 2012.jpg
depicts: The merry-go-round in the Jardin des Tuileries, Paris
note: A modern photo of the garden where she rode the merry-go-round and fed the swans as a child. Caption it as the Tuileries today, not as her own carousel.

title: File:Dinard - Plage Saint-Énogat 20210517.jpg
note: The village where she spent many childhood summers. Modern photo; unused in the storyboard, but available as an alternative for chapter 1.

title: File:Shanghai. The Bund, circa 1935.jpg
depicts: The Bund, Shanghai, on a postcard (posted 1939)
note: Period postcard of the Shanghai where the couple lived from 1931 and where they were later held. Portrait orientation.

title: File:SingaporeRiver-bumboats-196009.jpg
depicts: Bumboats on the Singapore River, September 1960
note: The river exactly as she painted it in the early 1960s. Strong period match; modest resolution.

title: File:Hermes Baby 1948.jpg
depicts: A 1948 Hermes Baby portable typewriter, the same model she typed her letters on
note: An object photo: the same model, not her own machine (hers is in the National Gallery archive and not openly licensed).
